pass5.name: UI migration + system audit
completedWork: Migrated all visible pages to schema-v2 domain facade/canonical user-data sources.
Replaced all visible legacy Pokémon images with PokemonSprite pinned icon-atlas rendering.
Migrated Teams and Fusion Lab to teams.v1.json/fusions.v1.json.
Replaced READY overclaims with account-verifiable starter/shiny checks and explicit in-run requirements.
Retired data.ts duplicate runtime constants to an empty documentation stub.
Added legacy-current guard so preserved pre-v2 snapshots cannot enter the schema-v2 domain.
Completed storage/backup/settings integration, mobile safe-area cleanup, and final source ownership audit.
Final deployment QA reported zero frontend errors and zero network errors.
knownLimitations: Fresh .prsv import required once after legacy migration.
iOS system file chooser may show extra media choices; Choose File remains the supported path.
Exact user-selected form/gender display is deferred; canonical form resolution remains stable.
No separate AppDeploy E2E run-group was emitted, so audit relied on compiled deployment QA, source regression checks, and the in-app architecture self-test.
